name: ربط وحدات المساعدة (جرعات/ضغط/فاصل/تعويض)
sample_text: وحدات المساعدة: لا تفصيل ربط خاص مرسوم؛ يُطبَّق ربط المعدات العام (وصلة مرنة + صمام عزل)
assumed: component lengths/bodies are catalogue-typical (components.json), not from the sheets
joint type per policy (threaded <= DN40, flanged above), not stated in the sheets
position along the carrier: nearest free straight interval from the unit outward
a unit with no drawn pipe touching a connection gets an assumed 80 cm stub from its footprint edge
the sheets show no specific connection detail for these units: the general equipment connection (flex + isolation) is assumed
